literature_anchors_inspected.citation: Bobbert MF, Gerritsen KG, Litjens MC, Van Soest AJ (1996) Med Sci Sports Exerc 28:1402-1412
literature_anchors_inspected.inspected_values: 6 male volleyball players; CMJ height on average 3.4 cm greater than SJ from the same start position; simulation ruled out elastic energy; attributed to active-state build-up before shortening
literature_anchors_inspected.use: qualitative mechanism/direction anchor for CMJ-SJ difference; not a validation target

literature_anchors_inspected.citation: Bobbert MF, Casius LJR (2005) Med Sci Sports Exerc 37:440-446
literature_anchors_inspected.inspected_values: 4-segment, 6-muscle simulation; CMJ-SJ height difference 0.4 cm (infinite dSTIM/dt) to ~2.5 cm (lowest rate studied)
literature_anchors_inspected.use: model-to-model comparison of the active-state mechanism; not human validation

literature_anchors_inspected.citation: Ferreira ARP, Macedo VOC, Boullosa D, Vieira A (2023) Int J Exerc Sci 16:1038-1051
literature_anchors_inspected.inspected_values: phase-duration metrics less consistent between days than force/impulse metrics (n=42); no numeric durations in abstract
literature_anchors_inspected.use: supports treating phase durations as strategy-dependent, not as fixed human norms
